items.question: When de-registering a company in Dubai, how much in AED must be paid for the certificate of dissolution and liquidator appointment?
items.fact: Dubai company de-registration requires AED 520 dissolution certificate fee

items.question: When de-registering a company in Dubai, how many days do debtors have to submit their claims after the liquidation announcement?
items.fact: Dubai liquidation announcement gives debtors 45 days for claims
